RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
At 7-20pm. tonight, C.P.S.1214 and C.P.C.2596, on Wang Jiang Jiang (汪正祥) patrol on Naining Road, saw a male Chinese throw a pamphlet to the ground. They picked this up, and finding it to be of a communistic nature, went to arrest him, when he threw a large paper envelope away. This was picked up by the police, and the man brought to the station along with four more pamphlets which were in his pocket and removed by C.P.S.
The envelope was found to contain two letters, sealed and addressed to Chinese, but with no addresses. These were opened, and each found to contain communistic pamphlets. A further search of the man's person revealed a note book with similar writings, and a piece of paper written in ink giving particulars of the price of printing machinery.
The arrested man was questioned, but denied all knowledge of the articles, even the note book, saying that he had just picked them from the ground when the police arrested him. Outline of propaganda for the struggle on the
occasion of the "February 7" Anniversary and
the end of the Year.

1. "February 7" this year is the 8th Anniversary of the
massacre by the militarist Wu Pei-fu - the executioner of
the Imperialists and the capitalists - of the Peking-
Hankow railway workers who were at that time (1923)
struggling for better working conditions under the
guidance of the Communist Party. "February 7" is the
day upon which the Chinese workers discharged the first
cannon-ball against the Imperialists, the militarists and
the capitalists. The "May 30" incident of 1925, the
great revolution of 1927 and the present splendidly efficient
Red Army and the development of the Soviet Districts can
be taken as the achievements of the "February 7" bloodshed.
Before "February 7", there is another occasion to be
observed on January 15, the Anniversary of the Death of
Comrades Liebknecht and Luxemburg while directing a
labourers' uprising opposing the World War during the
German Revolution in 1918. ................

“二七”周年纪念及年终斗争宣传大纲。

1. 今年的“二七”是军阀吴佩孚——帝国主义者和资本家的刽子手——屠杀在京汉铁路工人为争取更好工作条件而在共产党指导下进行斗争（1923年）的第八周年纪念日。“二七”是中国工人向帝国主义者、军阀和资本家发射第一颗炮弹的日子。1925年的“五卅”惨案、1927年的大革命以及当前高效强大的红军和苏区的发展，都可以被视为“二七”流血牺牲的成果。
在“二七”之前，还有另一个需要纪念的日子，即1月15日，李卜克内西和卢森堡同志逝世纪念日，他们在1918年德国革命期间领导工人起义反对世界大战时牺牲。 ................

Central Notification No.97.

Bearing on the struggle at the end of the year(1930);
Anniversary of Lenin's death; and the February 7
Movement.

1) January 15, 1931 is the 13th anniversary of the deaths
of comrades Liebkneck and Luxemburg; January 21 is the
7th Anniversary of the death of Lenin and February 7 is
the anniversary of the massacre of the Tsin-Han Railway
workers. Furthermore, during this period the Soviet
General Meeting is scheduled to take place. All these
events are to take place on the occasion of the Chinese
New Year.
In the last circular issued by the Central, an anti-
Lih-san Route movement has been started and therefore we
should exert ourselves to carry out this movement.

2) The economic situation of the world has reached the
danger point, but Soviet Russia, on the other hand, has
made rapid progress with the "Five Year Economic Plan".
This has terrified the imperialists and the Kuomintang
to such an extent that they have lost no time in aggravating
their suppressive movement against the Soviet; particularly
the "Red Army"(3)Therefore on the occasion of the various
anniversaries mentioned above, all our members who are
working in the various factories, peasants' villages,
military camps and schools should eliminate all partisans
of the "Lih-san" Route and prepare political and economical
slogans to be used during these movements. We must convince
the populace that we are fighting for a political as well
as an economical purpose. We should also understand that
through strikes we are not only supporting the Soviet but
also preparing ourselves to be competent to start and lead
an armed uprising.
In a word, we should urge all workers and proletarians
to declare a general strike and stage a demonstration on
the anniversary of February 7. We should eliminate all
adherents of the "Lih-san" Route because the failures on
the occasion of the "October Revolution" and the "Canton
Uprising" anniversaries has proved conclusively that the
Lih-san Route is obsolete and unsuitable.

4) The subjects to be used during the movement at the
end of the year are "Annual bonus; issue of wages in arrears;
issue of deposits; increase of wages; New Year Holidays;
Opposition to reduction in wages and Dismissal of workers."
The movement among railway workers, seamen and soldiers
occupies the most important part in our programme. We
may also urge the people to oppose the increase in rent
and the collection of miscellaneous taxes. In short we
should concentrate our attention and base our movement on
the needs of the people so as to gain their full support
and sympathy.
In the peasants' area, we should urge them to oppose the
increase in the land tax and refuse to pay any debts.
Among soldiers, we should make use of the following
demands: Issue of wages in arrears; Annual bonus; improvement
in treatment and stoppage of drill. Soldiers despatched to

中央通告第九十七号。

涉及年终（1930年）斗争；列宁逝世纪念日；以及“二七”运动。

1) 1931年1月15日是李卜克内西和卢森堡同志逝世十三周年纪念日；1月21日是列宁逝世七周年纪念日；2月7日是京汉铁路工人惨遭屠杀的纪念日。此外，在此期间计划召开苏维埃代表大会。所有这些事件都恰逢中国新年之际。
在中央发布的上一份通告中，已发起反对立三路线的运动，因此我们应努力开展这一运动。

2) 世界经济形势已达到危险点，但另一方面，苏维埃俄国在“五年经济计划”方面取得了迅速进展。这使得帝国主义者和国民党惊恐万分，他们不失时机地加剧了对苏维埃的镇压运动；特别是针对“红军”(3)因此，在上述各个纪念日之际，我们在各工厂、农村、军营和学校工作的所有成员应清除所有“立三”路线的派系分子，并准备在这些运动中使用的政治和经济口号。我们必须使民众相信，我们既为政治目的也为经济目的而战。我们还应认识到，通过罢工，我们不仅支持苏维埃，而且也在为自己具备发动和领导武装起义的能力做准备。
总之，我们应敦促所有工人和无产阶级在“二七”纪念日举行总罢工和示威游行。我们应清除所有“立三”路线的拥护者，因为“十月革命”和“广州起义”周年纪念日活动中的失败已确凿证明，立三路线已过时且不适用。

4) 年终运动中使用的主题包括“年终奖金；补发拖欠工资；退还存款；增加工资；新年假期；反对减薪和解雇工人。”
铁路工人、海员和士兵中的运动在我们的计划中占据最重要的部分。我们还可以敦促民众反对增加租金和征收杂税。简而言之，我们应该集中注意力，以民众的需求为基础开展运动，以获得他们的全力支持和同情。
在农村地区，我们应敦促他们反对增加土地税并拒绝偿还任何债务。
在士兵中，我们应利用以下诉求：补发拖欠工资；年终奖金；改善待遇和停止操练。被派往

'Workers' Correspondence Issue No. 1' bearing on the
financial status of the Nanking Government.

Shanghai, Jan. 20.

In view of the economic crisis together with the prolonged
period of civil war among the militarists, the financial status
of the Nanking militaristic Government has almost reached
complete bankruptcy. In order to prolong its existence,
it has depended upon loans and debenture bonds. On
top of these, still more loans are being made by various
provinces which are already in bankrupt states.

Further, the Nanking Government has increased the
customs revenues from January 1 this year and abolished
likin in order to relieve its financial embarrassment and
to attack communistic movements. It has also proposed
to convene a citizens' conference on May 5 to deceive the
people.

The treacherous Nanking Government first secured the approval
of the imperialists to increase customs revenues and granted them certain great
privileges in exchange. In November last year the Nanking
Government invited representatives of the various foreign powers to
Nanking to discuss the readjustment of domestic and foreign
loans. At that conference it was proposed to raise a
huge loan to be known as the 'Reorganization Loan' with the
new customs surtax as security. According to a report
which appeared in the Shanghai Tung Shin Pao (Jan. 18),
in December last year, the total amount of foreign loans
made to China is $1,700,000,000. Foreign loans have
more or less contributed to the civil wars among the militarists
in China.

The abolition of likin is equivalent to an increase
in customs revenues.

In November last year the Nanking Government promulgated
a law authorizing the levying of a special tax, a business
tax and a tax on goods leaving factories. These taxes are
intended to replace the losses which will be incurred after
the abolition of likin. The present Nanking officials
have deprived the people of all their interests by means of
these taxes.

Although the Nanking Government has issued debenture bonds,
increased customs revenues and imposed higher rates of taxes,
it is still unable to solve its financial difficulties. The
proposal to float a large foreign loan affords an excellent
opportunity to the imperialists to seize China. The American
imperialists propose to lend 100,000 ounces of silver to the
militarists of China. The British and the Canadian
Governments also intend to give a large loan to the Nanking
Government. The British imperialistic newspapers in Shanghai
have reported that the Nanking Government desires to raise a large
Reorganization Loan with customs revenue, railway profits
and salt taxes as security. A portion of this loan will be
earmarked for the adjustment of domestic and foreign loans,
while the remainder will be used to consolidate the Nanking
troops to attack communistic movements. It is
proposed that all domestic and foreign loans will be paid up
within thirty years.

According to the calculations of Dr. Kemmerer (?), an
American Adviser to the Ministry of Finance, the total amount of
domestic and foreign loans plus interest is approximately
$2,980,736,000.00.

《工人通讯》第一期，涉及南京政府的财政状况。

上海，1月20日。

鉴于经济危机以及军阀之间长期的内战，南京军阀政府的财政状况几乎已陷入完全破产。为了延续其存在，它一直依赖贷款和公债债券。除此之外，各个已经处于破产状态的省份还在举借更多的贷款。

此外，南京政府从今年1月1日起增加了关税收入并废除了厘金，以缓解其财政困境并打击共产主义运动。它还提议于5月5日召开国民会议以欺骗人民。

卖国的南京政府首先获得了帝国主义者对增加关税收入的批准，并以此交换给予他们某些重大特权。去年11月，南京政府邀请各外国列强代表前往南京，讨论调整内外债问题。在那次会议上，提议以新的关税附加税为担保，筹集一笔巨额贷款，称为“整理借款”。据《上海通社报》（1月18日）刊登的一篇报道，去年12月，外国对华贷款总额为1,700,000,000美元。外国贷款在某种程度上助长了中国军阀之间的内战。

废除厘金等同于增加关税收入。

去年11月，南京政府颁布了一项法律，授权征收特别税、营业税和出厂货物税。这些税收旨在弥补废除厘金后造成的损失。现任南京官员通过这些税收剥夺了人民的所有利益。

尽管南京政府发行了公债债券，增加了关税收入并提高了税率，但仍无法解决其财政困难。提出发行大规模外债的建议，为帝国主义者攫取中国提供了绝佳机会。美国帝国主义者提议向中国军阀提供10万盎司白银。英国和加拿大政府也打算向南京政府提供大额贷款。上海的英国帝国主义报纸报道称，南京政府希望以关税收入、铁路利润和盐税为担保，筹集一笔大规模的整理借款。这笔贷款的一部分将指定用于调整内外债，其余部分将用于整编南京军队以攻击共产主义运动。提议所有内外债将在三十年内还清。

据财政部美国顾问凯末尔博士（Dr. Kemmerer (?)）计算，内外债本金加利息总额约为2,980,736,000.00美元。

Central Notification No.202

The day (February 7) on which the Soviet General
Conference will be held is fast approaching, yet up
to the present very little has been achieved concerning
the election of representatives to attend the Conference
as well as the despatch of these representatives. More-
over it is noticed that not all the representatives are
being selected from the people.

It is the paramount duty of the Party to urge the
people to struggle for the success of the Soviet Political
Power and the establishment of a Soviet Central Government,
especially at present when the Imperialists and the
Kuomintang are endeavouring to annihilate the Red Army,
and conquer the Soviet Districts by force of arms, while
the Trotsky Clique is employing slogans opposing the
1st National Soviet General Conference with the object
of deceiving the people. The Party should mobilize all
its forces to oppose the attack upon the Soviet Districts
by the Imperialists and the Kuomintang, and at the
same time complete arrangements should be made for the
election of representatives from the proletariat to attend
the Conference.

All Party branches should, especially when the
Kuomintang is using slogans in support of the National
People's Convention to attack the Soviet, point out to
the people that according to the election regulations
of this deceitful Convention, only representatives of
landlords, capitalists and traitors belonging to "Yellow"
Labour or Peasants' Unions are permitted to participate
and furthermore this Convention will not interest itself
in the welfare of the proletariat. Also explain to
them that only through the Soviet Political Power can the
proletariat obtain relief and that the Soviet election
takes place only among the real populace. During this
propaganda campaign, efforts must be made to seize the
first opportunity to carry out the election of representatives
from among the real populace for participation in the
Soviet General Conference.

In conclusion, the various Party branches should
expedite the election of representatives and for their
despatch, at the same time intensifying the propaganda
opposing the National People's Convention and the
attack on the Soviet Districts by the Kuomintang and the
Imperialists. Representatives selected must be
despatched according to the instructions laid down by the
Central Preparatory Committee.

The Central.

中央通告第202号

苏维埃代表大会召开之日（2月7日）即将来临，但截至目前，关于选举出席大会的代表以及派遣这些代表的工作收效甚微。此外，注意到并非所有代表都是从民众中选拔出来的。

督促民众为苏维埃政权的成功和苏维埃中央政府的建立而斗争，是党的首要任务，特别是在当前帝国主义者和国民党正企图武力消灭红军、征服苏区，而托洛茨基派别正利用反对第一次全国苏维埃代表大会的口号以欺骗民众的时候。党应动员一切力量反对帝国主义者和国民党对苏区的进攻，同时应做好从无产阶级中选举代表出席大会的各项安排。

各党支部应当，特别是在国民党利用支持国民会议的口号来攻击苏维埃的时候，向民众指出，根据这个欺骗性会议的选举规定，只有地主、资本家和属于“黄色”工会或农会的叛徒代表才被允许参与，而且这个会议不会关心无产阶级的福利。还要向他们解释，只有通过苏维埃政权，无产阶级才能获得解脱，而且苏维埃选举仅在真正的民众中进行。在这次宣传运动中，必须努力抓住第一个机会，从真正的民众中执行代表的选举，以参加苏维埃代表大会。

总之，各党支部应加速代表的选举和派遣工作，同时加强反对国民会议以及反对国民党和帝国主义进攻苏区的宣传。选出的代表必须按照中央准备委员会下达的指令进行派遣。

中央。
1931年1月31日。

上海年终（1930年）斗争概况。

加速年终斗争运动和苏维埃小组的选举。

1. 年终斗争前言
在新年庆祝之际，世界各地，特别是中国的严峻经济形势，导致资本家加倍努力攻击人民。在中国，国民党一方面发动对红色苏维埃的攻击，另一方面利用四中全会等各种手段欺骗人民。这次会议达成的决议，即废除所有工会并禁止罢工，清楚地证明了国民党的阴谋。

2. 年终斗争的发展与意义
最近，闸北巴士公司和当铺宣布罢工，而电车公司、上海电话公司、本地印刷厂、药店、茂生纱厂等的员工都表现出积极的行动，以示反对增加工作量、解雇工人，并强制要求增加工资等。这些运动表明我们的日常斗争运动取得了一些发展。此外，租界巡捕房和华界公安局的镇压行动使工人们确信参加政治运动的必要性。所有这些都指向了陈独秀派和李立三路线在取消沿经济路线进行的日常斗争方面的错误。
在“白色恐怖”的可怕统治下，每一次经济斗争都很容易转化为政治斗争。因此，我们的同志不应忽视这些斗争，它们无疑将对蒋介石攻击红军造成沉重打击。简而言之，我们必须注意以下几点：
1. 抓住每一个机会取得胜利。
2. 扩大我们的人民组织。
3. 揭露国民党的欺骗手段。
4. 支持红军和苏区。

3. 经济斗争与政治斗争的联系
在所有斗争中，我们应该使用经济口号和政治口号，因为引入政治口号的使用将巩固工人反对压迫的决心

我们应加强我们的自卫队和纠察队，以应对“白色恐怖”。

党应在每一次运动中领导人民。应使公众相信，党在为他们谋利益的同时，也在扩大“红色”影响。

10. 加速在青年工人和女工中的工作
资本家在对待青年和女工方面，现在采取了比以往更加顽固的态度。因此，我们不应错过这个机会，要敦促青年和女工坚持他们的诉求，另一方面说服成年工人给予全力支持。

11. 穷人的斗争
穷人合作社将处理这一问题。

12. 春节期间的工作
应敦促工人无视国民党关于遵守阴阳历新年的命令。应建议他们在此时要求休假和双倍工资。

13, 党的各支部成员
14, 应严格按照本通告规定的指示履行其职责。
15. 他们应在新年、列宁纪念日和二七纪念日期间联合行动。最后，必须指出，反对“立三”路线的运动不容忽视。

江苏省委。

"Resolutions passed by 'Lih-san North Street Route' in
support of the International Route and opposition to Li-san
Route".

Passed by the meetings held by the route on 28.12.30
and 9.1.31.

A. The status of the Li-san Route and its consequences:
1. Li-san denounces the unequal revolutionary developments
and does not analyse the relative strength of the classes.
2. The Li-san route is a combination of the opportunism
raised prior to August 7, 1927; of Trotskyism and of the
principles of recklessness formed after August 7.
3. It requires protection in its organization by means of
patriarchal system.
4. It completely loses the spirit of Bolshevik self-
commentation.
5. It compels the comrades to make sacrifices, to isolate
themselves from the masses; to dissolve party organizations;
to obstruct the Chinese Party as well as the Chinese revolution.
B. The 4th Central Conference concerning the attitude of the
anti-Li-san route.
1. The 4th Central Conference at an urgent meeting convened
by the Central Provincial Committee denounced the comrades of the
lower ranks as being the fruit of the principles of mediation.
2. The 4th Central Conference has accepted part of the
resolutions passed by the 3rd Central Conference as suit. This
shows evidently that it stands in favour of the principles of
mediation in order to deceive the comrades and to safeguard the
Li-san route which is complete political bankruptcy and is
therefore unable to guide the Chinese revolution.
3. Although Li-Li-san has retired from the political
arena, he is still attached to the Central Headquarters. Loo Sang
is still attached to the Kiangnan Provincial Committee, although
he has been dismissed from the membership of the Central Committee.
The other leaders such as Hong Toong Fah, Jui Teiu Pah, Chow Ung
Lam and others are still attached to Central Headquarters and
Chen Sing Yu, who had formerly disclosed the secrets of the Party,
has been engaged as a clerk to the Kiangnan Provincial Committee.
Such policy is to deceive the comrades and is a complete
collapse of the organization.
4. The 4th Central Conference was convened by 19 votes to 18.
Amongst the 19 votes, there were two labour comrades and 17
intelligent members supporting the Li-san Route. There were 15
labour comrades amongst the 15 voters. Therefore the 4th Central
Conference completely wiped out the views of the labour comrades
and displayed the views of small capitalists.
5. Central notification No.96 and the supplementary
resolutions of November 25 were of a mediating nature. They have not
systematized the International Route but ignored the urgent mission
of the fight for the Soviet political power. As regards
organization, they have not reached a single fundamental solution.
However, this has been favoured by the 4th Central Conference.
6. Under the patriarchal system, the 4th Central Conference
desires to monopolize the sovereign rights of China--such as the
despatching of inspecting officers to branch offices.

第6号

1931年1月21日晚上7点20分，在Mining Road（音译）逮捕的Chang-Shang（□ □ □）身上搜获的传单译文。

“‘立三北街路线’支持国际路线、反对立三路线的决议”。

由该路线于1930年12月28日和1931年1月9日举行的会议通过。

A. 立三路线的现状及其后果：
1. 立三谴责不平衡的革命发展，且不分析各阶级的相对力量。
2. 立三路线是1927年8月7日之前产生的机会主义、托洛茨基主义以及8月7日之后形成的盲动主义原则的结合体。
3. 它要求其组织通过家长制系统进行保护。
4. 它完全丧失了布尔什维克自我批评的精神。
5. 它强迫同志们做出牺牲，使他们脱离群众；解散党组织；阻碍中国共产党以及中国革命。
B. 第四次中央会议关于反立三路线的态度。
1. 由中央省委召集的紧急会议上，第四次中央会议谴责下级同志是调和主义原则的产物。
2. 第四次中央会议接受了第三次中央会议通过的部分决议作为诉讼依据。这明显表明，它支持调和主义原则，以欺骗同志并维护立三路线，而该路线已彻底政治破产，因此无法指导中国革命。
3. 虽然李立三已退出政治舞台，但他仍依附于中央总部。Loo Sang（音译）虽已被撤销中央委员会委员资格，但仍依附于江苏省委。其他领导人如Hong Toong Fah（音译）、Jui Teiu Pah（音译）、Chow Ung Lam（音译）等人仍依附于中央总部，而曾泄露党机密的Chen Sing Yu（音译）已被聘为江苏省委的职员。这种政策是欺骗同志，也是组织的彻底崩溃。
4. 第四次中央会议是以19票对18票召开的。在这19票中，有两名工人同志和17名知识分子成员支持立三路线。在15名投票者中有15名工人同志。因此，第四次中央会议完全抹杀了工人同志的观点，并展示了小资产阶级的观点。
5. 中央第96号通知和11月25日的补充决议具有调和性质。它们没有系统化国际路线，而是忽视了争取苏维埃政权的紧迫使命。在组织方面，它们未达成任何根本性的解决方案。然而，这受到了第四次中央会议的青睐。
6. 在家长制系统下，第四次中央会议企图垄断中国的主权——例如向分支机构派遣视察员。

pages.en:
C. Be firm and eliminate the Li-san Route and accept the
International Route
1. Be firm minded in support of the International Route
and eliminate the Li-san route by action. Effect drastic
re-constructions of the problems as set out under the
dictation of the International Route.
2. Protest against the political route and overthrow
the decision of the 3rd Central Conference.
3. Ignore the 4th Central Conference and all its resolutions.
4. Overthrow the Central Provincial Committees, denounce
its delegates in the struggle against the Li-san Route and
obstruct all movements of active delegates.
5. The Far East Bureau will immediately call the 7th
General meeting of representatives to settle all problems affecting
the political organization and to bring about new political
reforms in the central and the provincial committees.
6. Support the district committees in their struggle
against the Li-san route.
7. Have Wang Tao-chung, Li Min-san, Jui Tsiu-yeh, Chow
Ung-seng, Lee Fang, Chen Kuo Yu and others struck off the
membership list; cancel all previous resolutions in support
and expulsion of the Li-san route; support the activities
of the comrades of the 4th Central Conference and participate in
the activities of the junior comrades and correct previous
errors.
8. All members of the party must struggle to support the
International Route and oppose the Li-san route as well
as obligatory principles.
a) Intensify the struggle of the Bolsheviks' line
and adopt precautionary measures against the possible
return of its leaders to obstruct the activities of the party.
b) During the struggle to eliminate the Li-san route
and the obligatory principles, intensify the struggle of the
Proletariat in the party to protest against the right
opportunists as well as those engaged in factional activities.
c) Intensify political discussions and self-criticism
in the branch offices.
d) Intensify the developing of our elements in the
party and invite all our comrades to participate in
administrative matters.
9. Draft immediately a plan of activities for the Kiangsu
provincial districts in accordance with the International
Route.

Chow Chien-fu, Secretary of Branch Office.
pages.zh:
C. 坚定立场，消除立三路线并接受国际路线
1. 坚定支持国际路线，并通过行动消除立三路线。按照国际路线的规定，对所述问题进行 drastic（原文如此，意为剧烈/彻底）重组。
2. 抗议该政治路线，推翻第三次中央会议的决定。
3. 无视第四次中央会议及其所有决议。
4. 推翻中央省委，谴责其在反对立三路线斗争中的代表，并阻挠活跃代表的所有行动。
5. 远东局将立即召开第七次代表大会，解决影响政治组织的所有问题，并在中央和省级委员会中实施新的政治改革。
6. 支持各区委员会在反对立三路线斗争中的行动。
7. 将Wang Tao-chung（音译）、Li Min-san（音译）、Jui Tsiu-yeh（音译）、Chow Ung-seng（音译）、Lee Fang（音译）、Chen Kuo Yu（音译）等人从党员名单中除名；取消此前支持和驱逐立三路线的所有决议；支持第四次中央会议同志的活动，参与初级同志的活动并纠正此前的错误。
8. 全体党员必须为支持国际路线、反对立三路线以及强制性原则而斗争。
a) 加强布尔什维克路线的斗争，并采取预防措施，防止其领导人回归以阻碍党的活动。
b) 在消除立三路线和强制性原则的斗争中，加强党内无产阶级的斗争，以抗议右倾机会主义者以及从事派系活动的人。
c) 加强分支机构的政治讨论和自我批评。
d) 加强党内我们元素的发展，并邀请所有同志参与行政事务。
9. 根据国际路线，立即起草江苏省各地区的行动计划。

Chow Chien-fu（音译），支部书记。
